source.source_name: SEC EDGAR — XBRL financial data (companyfacts + Financial Statement Data Sets)
source.attribution: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) — public domain

transport.rate_limit: <=10 requests/second; descriptive User-Agent required (SEC fair access)

parsing.notes: companyfacts URL: CIK zero-padded to 10 (CIK0000320193.json). Per concept, pick datapoint by form (10-K annual) + latest end; dedupe restatements by accn. Units tagged (USD/shares/USD-per-share). For full population use the quarterly Financial Statement Data Sets (num/sub/pre/tag.tsv).

mapping_rules.financials: Per fiscal year (form=10-K): revenue=RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax (or Revenues), net_income=NetIncomeLoss, assets=Assets, liabilities=Liabilities, equity=StockholdersEquity, cash=CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue. currency=USD.
mapping_rules.join: cik == sec_edgar.cik_str (zero-pad to 10 for the URL).

fixture_requirements: large filer with full us-gaap set (e.g. CIK 320193 Apple)
concept with restated values across filings (dedupe by accn)
quarterly Financial Statement Data Sets num.tsv slice

live_test_plan.smoke: GET companyfacts/CIK0000320193.json with a descriptive UA; assert Revenue + NetIncomeLoss + Assets present.
live_test_plan.full: Per-CIK companyfacts for the ticker universe (<=10 req/s), or harvest the quarterly Financial Statement Data Sets for all filers.

blockers: Coverage = SEC-reporting companies only (not the private-company universe).
